signatures.description: Implement a Go 1.26 package that resolves virtual addresses to physical frames by parsing /proc/self/pagemap against the kernel's real page-table geometry (x86_64 4-level, and 5-level when the CPU enables it), returning correct frames for 4KiB, 2MiB transparent-hugepage, and 1GiB hugetlbfs mappings. It must detect that unprivileged kernels mask PFNs to zero since 4.0 (CAP_SYS_ADMIN required) and degrade to an explicitly capability-reported mode instead of returning plausible garbage, then re-validate after a THP split or page migration using pagemap flags plus /proc/self/smaps Rollup and mincore. Acceptance requires byte-exact agreement between data read through the resolved frame and data written through a shared mapping, plus tests that force khugepaged collapse and a concurrent mremap mid-walk.
